rationale: EO 8818 (6 FR 3313, July 9, 1941; signed July 5, 1941) under "Revocation of Executive Orders" states "are hereby revoked:" and lists "Executive Order 5857, dated June 16," 1932. EO 5857 amended standing text of the Consular Regulations; the revocation is by name in a substantive reorganization of the documentation-of-merchandise rules (new chapter XV), so it extinguishes the amendments. No earlier end was found, no partial scope, and no saving clause appears. The 1989 OFR editorial note 'Revoked by EO 8818' agrees with the held text. Not operative on 2026-10-14.
